annotations.title: Monthly rateable value changes by sector

description: How the rateable values the Valuation Office AMENDED in one month moved across England (and Wales, from the October 2026 month), for one broad sector (industry, offices, retail or other, the VO's own grouping). Covers only the properties amended that month. Read pct_change with n_amended and median_mover_pct. For £ per m² or overpaid shares, use area_breakdown with group_by sector for an area. Costs 1 credit.

include.description: Optional extra sections for the answer. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.include_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored. Leave out unless the user asks for something the normal answer lacks.

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM. Omit for the latest complete month.

options.description: Optional extra settings by name. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.options_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored.

sector.description: One of: industry, offices, retail, other.

name: get_sector_statistics
